orderingPolicy: Security and operator benefit dominate complexity. For similar benefit, prefer lower complexity, fewer dependencies, higher reuse, lower maintenance and stronger demo/user value.

candidates.topic: Owner-selectable versioned authority profiles including explicit full-control lab semantics
candidates.dependencies: typed profile operands and actual host/OS ceiling facts
candidates.rationale: Effective-rights compilation already owns the capability; historical evidence adds required truth for FULL_CONTROL_LAB, OS ceilings, warnings and degraded audit boundaries.
candidates.integration: Extend AAS-003 acceptance/negative facts and AAS-029 migration visibility; do not create a second profile framework.

candidates.topic: Intent-/policy-first administration with typed deterministic plans
candidates.dependencies: typed intent, catalogue and effective-rights facts
candidates.rationale: AAS-014 already compiles intent and AAS-013/AAS-028 already own preview and onboarding.
candidates.integration: Require compact goal/rule/exception input and deterministic Plan/Diff without letting free text become authority.

candidates.topic: Early restricted bootstrap supervisor with staged authority
candidates.dependencies: bootstrap profile, health gates and setup facts
candidates.rationale: This is a guided-onboarding authority phase, not a distinct control plane.
candidates.integration: Add a separate diagnosis/status/typed-repair envelope and explicit promotion gates to AAS-028.

candidates.topic: Adaptive necessary-question setup with transparent progress, resume and cleanup
candidates.dependencies: setup state and verified explanation events
candidates.rationale: The safety-template onboarding control is the existing home; arbitrary question/time quotas would be counterproductive.
candidates.integration: Ask only material unknowns; show Plan, stages, health, warnings, receipts, resume and cleanup without promoting AAS-028 over I5 work.

candidates.topic: Emergency stop, revoke, receipts and recovery visibility
candidates.dependencies: protected stop epoch and effect gate
candidates.rationale: Directly covered by the independent freeze, recovery and audit controls.
candidates.integration: Make frozen, queued, ambiguous and recovery states visible; full-control mode must not be portrayed as an independent tamper-proof boundary.

candidates.topic: Atomic cumulative action, rate, cost and attention budgets
candidates.dependencies: durable reservations and reconciliation state
candidates.rationale: AAS-005 and AAS-019 deliberately split authority totals from runtime/cost/attention resources.
candidates.integration: Preserve atomic use-time causality and do not add a parallel quota subsystem.

candidates.topic: Authentication, authority, quota, idempotency and audit enforced on the actual effect path
candidates.dependencies: closed dispatcher, identity, budget, replay and audit contracts
candidates.rationale: This is the defining acceptance composition for existing effect-broker controls, not a new broker.
candidates.integration: Require named use-time evidence that each participating control causally gates the provider call.

candidates.topic: Machine-readable ownership ledger and atomic multi-writer model
candidates.dependencies: durable store, fencing and state ownership
candidates.rationale: Crash-safe effect state already requires authoritative ownership and writer semantics.
candidates.integration: Name the writer/ownership ledger and reject ambiguous or split-brain authority; retain external distributed-store non-claims.

candidates.topic: Prompt, tool, document and memory injection containment
candidates.dependencies: origin labels and typed action reconstruction
candidates.rationale: Exactly covered by AAS-009 with memory and egress supporting boundaries.
candidates.integration: No standalone hijack framework.

candidates.topic: Replay-safe effect reconciliation and separately authorised compensation
candidates.dependencies: provider idempotency/readback and durable state
candidates.rationale: The backlog already separates uncertain-effect reconciliation from rollback/cleanup authority.
candidates.integration: Keep ambiguity quarantined and compensation fresh-state/diff/receipt bound.

candidates.topic: Provider-neutral Admin-AI planning without Control-Plane authority
candidates.dependencies: provider-neutral typed intent/evaluator contract
candidates.rationale: Provider neutrality is an invariant of the existing compiler/effect-boundary split.
candidates.integration: Require every deterministic or model provider to emit untrusted candidates only; provider changes cannot alter authority.

candidates.topic: Format-aware safe artifact intake including Safetensors-oriented model handling
candidates.dependencies: artifact-type trust policy and verifier fixtures
candidates.rationale: AAS-025 already owns model/artifact type trust; a safe serialization format is one input, not proof of provenance or safety.
candidates.integration: Add format-aware negative fixtures and an explicit non-claim that Safetensors alone establishes trust.

candidates.topic: SPIFFE-shaped synthetic workload identity contract
candidates.dependencies: identity and token lifecycle contracts
candidates.rationale: AAS-007 already owns separate workload/human identity; SPIFFE shape improves the local contract without proving production IAM.
candidates.integration: Use synthetic trust-domain/workload fixtures and keep production SPIRE/IAM evidence blocked_external.

candidates.topic: Digest-only trace export without payload, PII or secrets
candidates.dependencies: verified local event chain and export policy
candidates.rationale: This is a privacy-preserving profile of the existing audit-export control.
candidates.integration: Add digest/link/source/time export mode and negatives for payload, PII and secret inclusion.

candidates.topic: Hard E2E evidence from intent through revoke, rollback or cleanup
candidates.dependencies: implemented controls and deterministic fixtures
candidates.rationale: AAS-030 is the recurring composition guard and already requires crash/concurrency/config-bound evidence.
candidates.integration: Require the applicable full chain and named fail-closed cases; documentation-only evidence gets no closure credit.

candidates.topic: Public one-click distribution and live local-LLM personalization
candidates.dependencies: release channel, model runtime and separate authorization
candidates.rationale: Useful product work but not a distinct local security control and externally gated.
candidates.integration: Keep deterministic provider support under AAS-028/032; defer distribution and live-model activation.

candidates.topic: Reproducible 1/2/5/10-cell performance, fairness and recovery benchmarks
candidates.dependencies: benchmark environment and implemented multi-cell/runtime paths
candidates.rationale: Security fault probes belong in AAS-030, but scale/performance claims require a separate performance evidence track.
candidates.integration: Do not add an Admin-AI security control; cross-reference AAS-030 when the runtime scope exists.

candidates.topic: Production ERP, CRM, mail, DMS and collaboration integrations
candidates.dependencies: live providers, credentials, tenancy, identity and privacy design
candidates.rationale: The PoC explicitly proves extension mechanisms rather than production-perfect integrations.
candidates.integration: No provider-specific backlog expansion until separately authorized and evidenced.

candidates.topic: NVIDIA/GPU mandatory baseline or alliance status as maturity evidence
candidates.dependencies: GPU ecosystem and external organisational claims
candidates.rationale: Explicitly rejected historically and supplies no security evidence by itself.
candidates.integration: None.

candidates.topic: Complex security marketplace before the PoC
candidates.dependencies: catalogue governance, identity, provenance and ecosystem operations
candidates.rationale: A closed inactive catalogue and artifact trust policy provide the proportional capability without marketplace machinery.
candidates.integration: None.

candidates.topic: Giant per-agent, container, port and capability administration switchboard
candidates.dependencies: large UI and per-resource policy framework
candidates.rationale: Directly contradicts the binding intent-/policy-first product decision.
candidates.integration: Preserve optional expert drill-down only; no second authority model.

candidates.topic: Immediate natural-language authoring, federation or autonomous-optimisation framework expansion
candidates.dependencies: all higher-priority controls plus live identity/model evidence
candidates.rationale: Duplicate of existing deliberately-later entries and disproportionate while I5 boundaries are open.
candidates.integration: Do not create new IDs or expand the existing P3 candidates.

integrationGate.condition: checkpoint is newer than a0b7a08999a8d7bfe7e654c05b41c04fa06dd78f, clean, and next is not AAS-003
